Name: AutoSeedAndFertilizer
Author: Exconvinced
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Auto-Seed And Fertilizer[/b][/size][/center]
[center]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/exconvinced/AutoSeedAndFertilizer/refs/heads/main/src/preview_marquee.gif[/img][/center]

[size=4][b]Introduction[/b][/size]
Preemptively mark tilled empty soils for placement of currently equipped seeds or fertilizers. Approach marked soils to automatically sow seeds or fertilizers.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GenericModConfigMenu[/url]﻿
[/list]
[size=4][b]Usage

[/b][/size][color=#e69138][b]Single-tile mode[/b][/color]
Equip a seed bag or a fertilizer. Hold [color=#e69138]right-mouse-button[/color] over a tilled soil to mark them. Move close to marked soils to automatically sow seeds or fertilizers in hand. To use this mode, disable [color=#e69138]Draw Rectangle To Mark Soils[/color] from the Generic Mod Config Menu.
[color=#e69138]
[center]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/exconvinced/AutoSeedAndFertilizer/refs/heads/main/src/preview.gif[/img][/center]

[b]Rectangular Marquee mode[/b][/color]
Equip a seed bag or a fertilizer. Hold [color=#e69138]right-mouse-button[/color] over a whole field to mark tilled soils within the rectangular area. Move close to marked soils to automatically sow seeds or fertilizers in hand. To use this mode, enable [color=#e69138]Draw Rectangle To Mark Soils[/color] from the Generic Mod Config Menu.
[color=#e69138]
[center]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/exconvinced/AutoSeedAndFertilizer/refs/heads/main/src/preview_marquee.gif[/img][/center]

[b]Auto-sowing mode[/b][/color]
Skip manually marking tilled soils. Instead, simply walk over the tilled soils to sow seeds/fertilizers. To use this mode, enable [color=#e69138]Always Sow on Any Tilled Soil[/color] from the Generic Mod Config Menu. Optionally, also enable [color=#e69138]Prevent Fertilizing Empty Soils[/color] to prevent accidental consumption of fertilizers to empty soils.


[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
In Generic Mod Config Menu, you may choose to:
[list]
[*][b]Consumable Seeds/Fertilizers[/b]: Choose whether to allow consumption of equipped seeds or fertilizers.
[*][b]Detection Range[/b]: Widen the distance between player and a closest marked soil to trigger auto-sowing.
[*][b]Execution Range[/b]: Widen the area around the player that will modify marked soils within the area upon auto-sowing.
[*][b]Always Sow on Any Tilled Soil[/b]: Skip manually marking tilled soils. Instead, simply walk over the tilled soils to sow seeds/fertilizers.
[*][b]Prevent Fertilizing Empty Soils[/b]: Always ensure that the tilled soil is already occupied before allowing fertilizers to be sowed.
[*][b]Draw Rectangle To Mark Soils[/b]: Instead of selecting one tile at a time, draw a rectangular area to mark tilled soils.[b] [/b]
[/list]

[center]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/exconvinced/AutoSeedAndFertilizer/refs/heads/main/src/preview_generic_mod_config_menu.png[/img][/center]

[size=4][b]Inspiration[/b][/size]
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/YunHikari?gameId=1303]YunHikari[/url]'s suite of Auto-Tools on [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/YunHikari?gameId=1303]NexusMods[/url].
